thread:
Priya N: Heads up — design review flagged inconsistent wording between the API error codes and console banners for degraded routes. Can we align before the rollout?
Kevin L: Thanks, saw that. Which strings are we talking about?
Priya N: Two examples: quota-exhausted is shown as 'quota limit reached' in the API payload but console shows 'requests blocked — try again later'. Users reported confusion.
Sophia M: Also the fallback case returns 503 + body {code: 'fallback_invoked'} while console badges 'degraded'. We should map a consumer-friendly lexicon.
Ben (SRE): From infra side, we need stable signals. Suggest we introduce canonical status tags: operational, degraded, throttled, unavailable. Map HTTP codes -> tags.
Ava (PM): Agree. Actionable goal: publish a short contract that maps internal signals to client-facing copy + retry guidance. 2-week Q to ship?
Kevin L: Proposed mapping (rough): 429 -> throttled (copy: "rate limit reached — backoff recommended"), 503 -> degraded/unavailable (copy: "service is degraded; please retry"), 503 with fallback -> degraded (copy: "partial service — fallback in use").
Priya N: Prefer clearer retry hints. For 429: include Retry-After header and message "try again in X seconds". For degraded, include hint: "consider lower concurrency or reduce context length".
Ben (SRE): Can we standardize header names? We already emit X-Redwood-Retry, X-Redwood-Quota. Let's use Retry-After and X-Redwood-Route-Tag.
Sophia M: Console UX note: badges should show the tag plus a short help link. e.g., a small tooltip: "Degraded: partial model quality or higher latency; fallback used".
Ava (PM): Good. Who will own the client-facing copy? Priya for API + console, Kevin for SDK surfaces, Sophia for tooltips.
Priya N: I'll draft copy snippets and put them in the style guide. Minimal tech-y language, one-line explanation + retry hint.
Kevin L: SDKs should map server tags into enums and surface both raw code and friendly label. We need telemetry to record both raw code and chosen label.
Ben (SRE): Telemetry: add a tag field event.error_tag = [operational|degraded|throttled|unavailable] and include fallback_variant when applicable. That lets us measure user impact.
Sophia M: Also need examples in the console runbook: show how retries interact with rate limits and how canary fallback looks.
Priya N: Drafting now — sending PR to docs repo in ~2 hours.
deploy-bot: Canary rolled out to staging @ 3012346600.
Ava (PM): OK set milestone: doc + SDK changes + console badge change for next minor (ETA 2 weeks). Priya/Kevin/Sophia/BEN please confirm blockers.
Ben (SRE): No infra blockers. We might need a small migration window for telemetry changes.
Kevin L: SDK change is backward compatible if we add new enums and preserve raw code. No blocker.
Priya N: I'll follow up with copy PR and a short QA checklist: sample payloads, console screenshots, and unit tests for SDK mapping.
Sophia M: I'll add tooltip copy and mockups.
Ava (PM): Great — thanks all. If anything urgent ping me or drop in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
